title: Seasonal Family Events: Halloween, Christmas and More
description: Seasonal family days out all year: Easter trails, summer festivals, Heritage Open Days, pumpkin picking, Halloween, Christmas light trails and Santa.
h1: Seasonal days out all year round
intro: Every season has its own magic: spring lambs, summer festivals, autumn pumpkins and Christmas lights. Here’s what to look forward to, and when to book.

image.alt: Twinkling red and white festive lights

blocks.title: Scout’s seasonal verdict
blocks.text: The best seasonal slots sell out early. Book Christmas experiences in October and Halloween events in September.

sections.html:
• Spring: lambing at farm parks, Easter egg trails, bluebell walks.
  • Summer: festivals, beaches, open-air theatre, the summer bucket list.
  • Autumn: pumpkin picking and Halloween, Heritage Open Days.
  • Winter: Santa, light trails and panto, ice skating.

faqs.q: When should I book Christmas days out?
faqs.a: As early as you can. Popular Santa experiences and weekend light-trail tickets often sell out in October and November.

cardText: Easter, summer, Halloween and Christmas fun.
